title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash 2807c004092b… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash 2807c004092b2c84f1d3e9cefc5277d54a42fadce97788e02e8098fd7ff8ba86 was observed by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors during attacker activity on 2026-11-02. The file is associated with the ATT&CK technique T1105 (Ingress Tool Transfer) and was seen originating from attacker infrastructure in France. This hash corresponds to a specific malicious payload such as a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool that was staged or delivered during the attack. Organizations are advised to match this hash against files in their environments and threat intelligence feeds.
